title: Stunning Sagrada Familia
text: Truly awe-inspiring! The guided tour of the Sagrada Família was one of the highlights of my trip to Barcelona. Our guide explained everything in such a fascinating way, and it made me appreciate the details even more. The stained glass windows, the light, the architecture—everything is magical. I would 100% recommend taking the tour instead of going on your own. Unforgettable experience!
author: giuliavB6183FP
